sentences.en: Athletes must be tough not only physically, but also mentally.
sentences.zh: 运动员在身体上和精神上都必须坚强。

sentences.en: Sami was physically and psychologically tortured by an abusive father.
sentences.zh: 萨米被虐待的父亲在身体和心理上折磨着。

sentences.en: Sami isn't the type of person to physically hurt people.
sentences.zh: 萨米不是那种会动手打人的人。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：physical（身体的）+ly（表副词）→身体上
